H: The Vantrue Sonnet 1 Pro is a compact front-facing dash cam that records the road ahead in 2.5K (2592 x 1944) resolution. H: Night Vision: The S1 Pro uses a Sony STARVIS 2 sensor for clear low-light and nighttime recording. HDR balances bright and dark areas in high-contrast scenes, such as tunnel exits, oncoming headlights and harsh sunlight. Vantrue's PlatePix technology is designed to make licence plates easier to read in strong backlight and low light. The camera is compatible with an optional CPL polarizing filter to reduce windshield glare and reflections.
AI Driver Alerts: Vantrue Intelligence adds AI-based driving alerts to help the driver stay aware of hazards on the road.

Parking Protection: The 24-hour parking mode includes collision detection, motion detection with customizable settings, and energy-saving recording modes. The camera can save up to 15 seconds of footage before an event, so the lead-up to an incident is captured. 24-hour parking mode requires a hardwire kit.

LTE Connectivity (Optional): The S1 Pro supports LTE, but the LTE module is sold separately. With the module installed, owners get real-time remote live view, GPS location tracking, geofencing, cloud storage and incident alerts.

Built-in GPS logs route, speed and location with each recording, which helps with insurance claims and incident reviews. Built-in Wi-Fi and the free Vantrue app let owners view, download and share clips, adjust settings and install over-the-air firmware updates. Multilingual voice commands allow hands-free operation, and the clock adjusts automatically for daylight saving time in North America. A supercapacitor instead of a battery gives better reliability in hot and cold weather. The camera supports microSD cards up to 512GB.

The S1 Pro 1-Channel suits daily commuters, new drivers and anyone who wants reliable, high-resolution front recording in a compact, affordable package. A rear camera can be added later for front and rear coverage.
